x: 1938 was a quiet year for Ted but in the first few days of January 1939 he finished second in the Middlesex Cross-country championship, and the Cadogan A.C. team (consisting entirely of Belgrave runners as follows:- Stimpson 2, D. Patience 4, Shields 7, Allum 14, Tobin 15, F.R.

Duffett, L.L.King, F.R.Webb (Ashcombe A.C.) and myself. My earliest programme is dated August 26th 1926, this is for a Club Handicap Meeting, four events, 89 entries, only three entries from the 1938 list - A.E.Duffett, L.L.King, and myself.
